risk_note: Reading only: no write path, no stored data, no contract change. withdrawal_approve, withdrawal_reject, withdrawal_manual_paid, payout_batch_execute and payout_watermark_create had no entry in audit-log-view's RULES, so target_type, target_id and permission derived null and GET /admin/v1/audit-logs?target_id= found nothing, which finance needs when checking a withdrawal. The three withdrawal actions derive withdrawal and the withdrawal id. A rejection by a person is under withdraw.review; the system's NEGATIVE_BALANCE derives permission null, so it does not read as done under a point. payout_batch_execute is found by batch id only, and its whole-batch rejection has no target (accepted by the orchestrator 22:12: finance goes through the batch id on the withdrawal's detail). target_type is free text in the contract.
